title: Disk 100% full causing write failures across services
symptoms: OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device. Log rotation stopped. Database WAL writes failing: PostgreSQL FATAL: could not write to file pg_wal. Application health checks failing. 70% of API requests returning 500. df -h shows /var at 100%.
root_cause: Application debug logging was left enabled in production after a troubleshooting session. DEBUG level logs were generating 2GB/hour compared to normal 50MB/hour. Log rotation was configured for daily rotation but max size was not configured. /var/log filled in 12 hours.
fix_applied: 1. Removed largest log files under /var/log/app/debug-*. 2. Restarted application with LOG_LEVEL=INFO. 3. Configured logrotate with size-based rotation: maxsize 500M. 4. Added disk usage monitoring alert at 80%. 5. Set application log retention to 7 days.
